svg.title: MCP collapses M x N - and draws a new red line
svg.desc: A hand-drawn two-panel diagram. On the left four hosts are wired to five services by twenty tangled red lines labelled M times N equals 20 integrations. On the right the same hosts and services each connect to one hachured green MCP bar, nine clean lines, M plus N equals 9, with a note that six assistants and twenty services go from 120 to 26. Beneath the right panel a heavy red dashed TRUST BOUNDARY separates the model from the filesystem, the database and a shell, and a thick red arrow labelled tool result crosses it upward, annotated that what comes back up is untrusted data the model cannot distinguish from an instruction. A shell tool implemented as subprocess.run with shell=True is struck through as RCE with a docstring, beside a green hardening box; fourteen lab attacks succeeded five times on v1 and zero times on v3.
